description: Four sheet breaks in six hours at the second press. Wet streaks along the tending-side edge before each break. Felt permeability check showed the second press bottom felt well below target.
suspected_cause: Felt filling up with pitch and stickies from the recycled furnish.
root_cause: Bottom felt plugged with pitch and stickies. High-pressure shower nozzles were partly blocked, so the felt was not being cleaned on the run.
action_taken: Cleared the shower nozzles, ran an off-line caustic felt wash and increased the felt conditioning chemical. Felt changed at the next planned shutdown.

description: Shift B: web brk x4 after PR2. Moist streak TS edge. Uhle box vac dropping, fabric looks glazed and tight. Ran F/W, ok for now.
suspected_cause: Fabric loaded up, uhle box not drawing.
root_cause: HP shower header choked, fabric not conditioned.
action_taken: Pulled and rodded HP shower nozzles, chem wash on fabric.

description: Holes and spots appearing in the sheet, followed by breaks at the size press. Lab found slime deposits in the machine chest and on the headbox walls.
suspected_cause: Microbiological growth in the wet-end system.
root_cause: Biocide dosing pump had tripped three days earlier with no alarm configured, so biofilm built up in the short circulation.
action_taken: Restarted the dosing pump, shock-dosed biocide, boiled out the headbox and added a low-flow alarm on the dosing pump.

description: Customer complaint: pinholes and dirt specks on reels 4410 to 4416. Brownish gummy lumps found in the wire pit, sour smell.
suspected_cause: Deposits breaking off somewhere in the wet end.
action_taken: Hand-cleaned the wire pit, extra washup.

description: Basis weight varying by about 3 g/m2 in machine direction, headbox pressure hunting. Unusual rumbling noise from the fan pump.
suspected_cause: Wire pit level run too low.
action_taken: Operator retrained on level setpoints; setpoint raised.

description: MD grammage swings, total head unstable, cavitation sound at the fan pump. Wire pit level control valve LV-301 found sticking at 40%.
root_cause: Sticking level control valve let the wire pit level drop, drawing air into the fan pump suction.
action_taken: Replaced the positioner, stroke-tested the valve, added a deviation alarm on wire pit level.

area_or_equipment: Tablet press TP-02, Product A 500 mg
description: In-process control: hardness below limit and capping seen on 6 of 20 tablets. Batch placed on hold. Compression force within range.
root_cause: Fluid bed dryer inlet air temperature probe read 6 C low, so the dryer ran hotter than its set point. Granule LOD 0.6% against a specification of 1.5 to 3.0%.
action_taken: Probe replaced and calibrated. Granule LOD check added before compression. Batch reworked under an approved protocol.

description: Friability failed, tabs laminating with the top layer splitting off. Upstream LOD on granules very low. FBD-1 temp trend looked normal on the HMI.
root_cause: FBD-1 inlet temperature sensor drifted out of calibration.
action_taken: Sensor recalibrated, calibration interval shortened from 12 to 6 months.

description: Grade A non-viable particle counts (0.5 um) exceeded the alert limit three times during filling, each during a glove-port intervention.
root_cause: Pinhole in the glove at port 4. Glove integrity test was a week overdue.
action_taken: Glove replaced and all gloves tested. Glove test schedule moved into the maintenance system with reminders. QA assessed batch impact.

description: Settle plate at position 3 grew 1 CFU in Grade A, identified as skin flora. The plate sits next to the barrier arm port used for line clearance.
root_cause: Operator technique. Operator retrained on aseptic behaviour.

description: Relative humidity rose to 71% for nine hours overnight. Alarm was sent but not acknowledged until the morning shift.
root_cause: Steam humidifier solenoid valve stuck open. Alarm escalation went to a shared inbox nobody watches out of hours.
action_taken: Valve replaced. Alarm escalation changed to the on-call phone. Impact on stability samples assessed.

description: Monday logger download: RH spike to 74% on Saturday night, temp OK. Water pooling under the steam unit.
